brief: First create the fixture project: pnpm exec tsx tests/fixtures/bench/reference-project.ts --project bench-reference-plan --variant plan (synthetic ffmpeg media, character and location cards supplied approved as fixture data, pipeline/shot-list.json and pipeline/material.json). The project already exists: work only on its reference inputs (pipeline/references.json, derivatives and packs); do not run film:init, project:new or a render. Following the ai-film playbook and the asset-planner brief, plan the reference inputs of every generated shot with the repository's commands (refs:plan draft and check; refs:derive for a derivative the plan proposes; refs:pack prepare for every shot whose inputs are ready), so that refs:plan --action check is clean and every generated material item has a shot in pipeline/references.json or a referencePlan "none" with its reason. Never type reference markers by hand. Stop at the pack approval gate: record no rights or approval and generate nothing. Write bench-result.json as {"blocked": true, "gate": "<the gate you stopped at>"}.
